_doc: Corrections applied to spec/ir.json before generation, for upstream spec defects. Each entry says why.

sql.TransferOwnershipRequest.object_id.why: The upstream spec types this path parameter as the struct TransferOwnershipObjectId ({new_owner}); databricks-sdk-go formats that struct into the URL ("{alice@example.com}"). The REST API takes the object's ID string, as documented at docs.databricks.com/api/workspace/dbsqlpermissions/transferownership.
